title: Public eval suites allowlist
description: Decides which raw eval suites in gs://guidance-evals are rebuilt into the public dashboard. Changed by pull request only. Policy rules beyond this shape (e.g. wildcard patterns must start with nightly-) are enforced by src/harness/public/allowlist.ts.

include.description: Suite IDs or glob patterns (* and ? only) that are eligible for publishing, e.g. nightly-*-codex_cli.

exclude.description: Exact suite IDs that must not be published even if they match include.

releasedModels.description: Model identifiers (as recorded in evals.json#model) that may appear publicly. Empty means nothing publishes.
